external_collaboration.evidence_quote: I had the opportunity to study under the Erasmus program during spring semester 2015/2016 academic year in Šiauliai State College. The receiving institution greeted us very well. We were told in details about every possible question or problem we might have.

Koledžā ir noslēgti līgumi 7 dažādās ES valstīs. Līgumi noslēgti par abām studiju programmām.
